hook.headline: Cameron Diaz's longevity plate, *decoded.*
hook.sub: What she's said she eats on her Mediterranean, 80/20 approach — and what it looks like *rescaled to you.*

what.headline: Mediterranean, whole-food, 80/20.
rows: Savory oats with **zucchini, collard greens & egg whites** — her go-to whole-food breakfast.
**Whole-wheat & quinoa pasta** as staple grains, a **rice-based probiotic drink,** and a daily squeeze of lemon.
**Crowds out refined sugar & processed food** with whole foods — an **80/20** framework, not rigid restriction.
what.source: Sources: People (on "The Body Book"); Cameron Diaz, "The Body Book" / "The Longevity Book".

science.headline: One of the most-studied patterns — and 80/20 is doable.
checks: Mediterranean eating is **associated with** better heart health — lower LDL & blood pressure.
In the landmark **PREDIMED** trial, a Mediterranean diet with olive oil or nuts was linked to **about a third fewer major cardiovascular events.**
It's also **associated with** healthy aging & longevity (Blue Zones).
science.caveat: "Associated with" isn't a guarantee — and **her calorie & protein needs aren't yours.**
science.source: Per Mayo Clinic; PREDIMED (NEJM) / NCBI review.

catch.headline: Her plate was built for *her* body & goals.
catch.body: What works at her calorie and protein needs won't automatically fit yours. Copy the exact plate — the portions, and the macros — and it simply may not match your day.

claims.headline: Cameron Diaz starts her day with savory oatmeal loaded with zucchini, collard greens, and egg whites as her go-to whole-food breakfast
claims.body: In a People feature on her diet and exercise habits, Cameron Diaz described making a savory oatmeal bowl with zucchini, collard greens, and egg whites as a regular morning meal. She also highlighted whole-wheat and quinoa pasta as staple grains, and has spoken about drinking a rice-based probiotic beverage and squeezing fresh lemon daily. Her overall approach centers on crowding refined sugar and processed foods out of her diet by replacing them with whole, nutrient-dense ingredients, using an 80/20 framework that leaves room for flexibility without rigid restriction.

claims.headline: Cameron Diaz views aging as something to embrace actively, not fight, and sees food and daily habits as the foundation of long-term vitality
claims.body: In a Good Morning America interview, Cameron Diaz discussed her broader wellness philosophy as one of acceptance and active participation in her own health rather than resistance to aging. She expressed a view that understanding how the body changes over time, and responding with intentional food choices and lifestyle habits, is more effective and sustainable than chasing a fixed youthful ideal. This philosophy underpins her approach to eating, which focuses on consistent whole-food habits rather than short-term diets or extreme restriction.
